title: New Asset and New Customer windows are as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click New Asset.
  3. Open the Customers list.
  4. Click New Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • New Asset shows its usual fields and no "Internal category".

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • New Customer shows its usual fields and no "Internal customer".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R7: “Edit Customer shows the checkbox "Internal customer" as the last field of the dialog, below "PO is required", with the helper "Work orders for this customer are internal: no prices, no invoice, parts cost posts to the expense account of the internal category." When ticked, the select "Default internal category" appears under it, listing the active Internal categories, General Internal preselected. It is shown while the setting is on (S1-N4 for the exception). New Customer does not show it: a customer is flagged after it exists, from Edit Customer or the modal. The checkbox and the modal are the only places the flag is set; ticking it on Save flags the customer (with the dialog of S1-R11 when open billable work orders exist).”
  • S1-R15: “Edit Asset of an internal customer shows, after the existing fields and under a divider, the select "Internal category" (the active Internal categories; empty means the customer's default) with the helper, led by the QuickBooks mark, "Categories are mapped to QuickBooks expense accounts. This one is where the asset's internal work orders post. Leave it empty to use the customer's category, [customer's default]." The field is not shown on assets of other customers, nor while the setting is off. A new internal work order on the asset takes this category (S2-R1).”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 3738 (TP-546): “New Customer and New Asset requests byte-identical; shop supplies validation unchanged for non-flagged customers”
